title: Portrayal rack file (v2)
description: A Rack Builder document: one or more racks, the devices in them, and the cables between their ports. What site/rack/model.js parseDoc accepts and serialize writes.

version.description: The file version. Older files are migrated on load; newer ones are refused.

id.description: The document's id, unique in a browser's library.

racks.description: The racks. The Rack Builder edits the first.

items.description: Devices and cable managers on the rails.

zeroU.description: Side-mounted parts along the attachment points. Reserved: none can be placed yet.

dcim.description: Names a NetBox or Nautobot import needs. Present only once set; unknown fields are kept.

numbering.description: Which way the U labels count. Positions are always stored bottom-up.

thread.description: The thread of tapped holes; null for square.

railDepth.description: Millimeters between front and rear rails; null on two posts.

usableDepth.description: Millimeters from the front rail to the deepest point a device may reach.

ref.description: A catalog rack this frame was taken from, if any.

id.description: Unique within the rack, and never reused while a cable end names it.

ref.description: The device, by its catalog ref.

label.description: The name shown on the drawing.

ru.description: The U its bottom sits in, counted bottom-up.

face.description: The face it is mounted on.

swaps.description: What the Explorer seated: slot path to part ref.

on.description: A cable manager's host: the id of the device it bolts over.

unit.description: Which of the host's units, from 1 at its bottom.

item.description: The device's id. A removed device's id is kept, and the end reads as loose.

path.description: The port's path on the face.

view.description: Which of the device's own panels the port is on.

waypoint.description: One stop on a route: an element of a placed device's drawing (item and via), or a lane beside the rails at a U (lane and ru).

item.description: A placed device's id, with via.

via.description: The element of that device's drawing the cable passes through, such as a ring or a duct.

lane.description: A lane beside the rails, with ru.

ru.description: The U the lane is crossed at.

media.description: The cable type (os2, om3, om4, om5, cat6, cat6a, dac, aoc), or empty.

unit.description: As written; m when the file stated none.

source.description: Where it came from: entered, or routed when the Rack Builder worked it out from the route.

measured.description: Meters along the route, before rounding up to a stock length. Present when the source is routed.

lengthAsWritten.description: A length the loader could not use, kept whole as it was written.

route.description: The waypoints the cable runs through, in order. Empty means the Rack Builder chooses the way.

routeEdited.description: True once someone has changed the route by hand, so it is no longer chosen for them.

routeAsWritten.description: A route containing an entry the loader could not read, kept whole as it was written. The readable waypoints are in route.
